reason: I already treat settlement emails as spam, so a free-during-beta site asking me to make an account before I go file on the official form feels like the same hustle. If I ever actually wanted to claim something I'd Google the case and go straight to the administrator, then leave.
objection: If it's free now, what's the catch when they start charging — and the listings aren't even verified until I check the official site myself anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A notice from my bank or the court pointing me here for one settlement I already know applies, with a direct link to the official claim form and no account required. I still wouldn't pay later.
